entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:1
segments: ¶"When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land the LORD your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:2
segments: "you shall separate three cities for yourself in the midst of your land which the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:3
segments: "You shall prepare roads for yourself, and divide into three parts the territory of your land which the LORD your God is giving you to inherit, that any manslayer may flee there.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:4
segments: "And this [is] the case of the manslayer who flees there, that he may live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, not having hated him in time past-

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:5
segments: "as when [a man] goes to the woods with his neighbor to cut timber, and his hand swings a stroke with the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and strikes his neighbor so that he dies-he shall flee to one of these cities and live;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:6
segments: "lest the avenger of blood, while his anger is hot, pursue the manslayer and overtake him, because the way is long, and kill him, though he [was] not deserving of death, since he had not hated the victim in time past.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:7
segments: "Therefore I command you, saying, 'You shall separate three cities for yourself.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:8
segments: "Now if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you the land which He promised to give to your fathers,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:9
segments: "and if you keep all these commandments and do them, which I command you today, to love the LORD your God and to walk always in His ways, then you shall add three more cities for yourself besides these three,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:10
segments: "lest innocent blood be shed in the midst of your land which the LORD your God is giving you [as] an inheritance, and [thus] guilt of bloodshed be upon you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:11
segments: "But if anyone hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises against him and strikes him mortally, so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:12
segments: "then the elders of his city shall send and bring him from there, and deliver him over to the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:13
segments: "Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall put away [the guilt of] innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:14
segments: ¶"You shall not remove your neighbor's landmark, which the men of old have set, in your inheritance which you will inherit in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:15
segments: "One witness shall not rise against a man concerning any iniquity or any sin that he commits; by the mouth of two or three witnesses the matter shall be established.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:16
segments: "If a false witness rises against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:17
segments: "then both men in the controversy shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who serve in those days.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:18
segments: "And the judges shall make careful inquiry, and indeed, [if] the witness [is] a false witness, who has testified falsely against his brother,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:19
segments: "then you shall do to him as he thought to have done to his brother; so you shall put away the evil from among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:20
segments: "And those who remain shall hear and fear, and hereafter they shall not again commit such evil among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 19:21
segments: "Your eye shall not pity: life [shall be] for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
